nanananda_verbatim:
Are released in the experience of cessation, it is they that are the
dispellers of death.
plain_english_below: Are released in the experience of stopping, it is they that are the dispellers of death.
tts_line: Are released in the experience of stopping, it is they that are the dispellers of death.

nanananda_verbatim:
It could indeed be expected of a noble disciple who has faith that he
will dwell with energy... that he will be mindful... that he will gain
concentration, will gain one-pointedness of mind, having made release
the object... that he will understand thus: 'This saṃsāra is without a
conceivable beginning... But the remainderless fading away and
cessation of ignorance... the stilling of all preparations... the
destruction of craving, detachment, cessation, extinction.' That
wisdom of his, Venerable Sir, is his faculty of wisdom.
plain_english_below: It could indeed be expected of a noble disciple who has faith that he will dwell with energy... that he will be mindful... that he will gain concentration, will gain one-pointedness of mind, having made release the object... that he will understand thus: 'This samsara is without a conceivable beginning... But the remainderless going out and stopping of not seeing how it works... everything the mind makes comes to a stop... the wanting ends, nothing pulls you any more, stopping, going out, like a flame with no fuel.' That wisdom of his, Venerable Sir, is his faculty of wisdom.
tts_line: It could indeed be expected of a noble disciple who has faith that he will dwell with energy... that he will be mindful... that he will gain concentration, will gain one-pointedness of mind, having made release the object... that he will understand thus — 'This samsara is without a conceivable beginning... But the remainderless going out and stopping of not seeing how it works... everything the mind makes comes to a stop... the wanting ends, nothing pulls you any more, stopping, going out, like a flame with no fuel.' That wisdom of his, Venerable Sir, is his faculty of wisdom.

nanananda_verbatim:
Whatever is prepared is not worthwhile, and yet, it is by means of
this prepared noble eightfold path that the Buddha clears the path to
the unprepared.

nanananda_verbatim:

nanananda_verbatim:
All those who came out of that hall, except this discerning one, were
spectators. He was not one of the audience, because he had an insight
into the magic show from his hiding place on the stage.
plain_english_below: All those who came out of that hall, except this discerning one, were spectators. He was not one of the audience, because he had an insight into the magic show from his hiding place on the stage.

nanananda_verbatim:
He knows that, given ignorance, they are true, and that they are
falsified only when ignorance fades away in one who sees the cessation.
Fortified with that understanding, he does not categorically assert the
sense-data as true, nor does he reprimand those who assert them as the
truth. That is why the Buddha advocates a tolerant attitude in this
discourse.
plain_english_below: He knows that, given not seeing how it works, they are true, and that they are falsified only when not seeing how it works fades away in one who sees the stopping. Fortified with that understanding, he does not categorically assert the sense-data as true, nor does he reprimand those who assert them as the truth. That is why the Buddha advocates a tolerant attitude in this discourse.
tts_line: He knows that, given not seeing how it works, they are true, and that they are falsified only when not seeing how it works fades away in one who sees the stopping. Fortified with that understanding, he does not categorically assert the sense-data as true, nor does he reprimand those who assert them as the truth. That is why the Buddha advocates a tolerant attitude in this discourse.

nanananda_verbatim:
To one detached from percepts there are no bonds, to one released
through wisdom there are no delusions, those who hold on to percepts
and views, go about wrangling in this world.
plain_english_below: To one detached from percepts there are no bonds, to one released through wisdom there are no delusions, those who hold on to percepts and views, go about wrangling in this world.
tts_line: To one detached from percepts there are no bonds, to one released through wisdom there are no delusions, those who hold on to percepts and views, go about wrangling in this world.

nanananda_verbatim: Just as in the case of a fire blazing like a block of iron in point of compactness, when it gradually calms down, no path it goes by can be traced.
plain_english_below: Just as in the case of a fire blazing like a block of iron in point of compactness, when it gradually calms down, no path it goes by can be traced.
tts_line: Just as in the case of a fire blazing like a block of iron in point of compactness, when it gradually calms down, no path it goes by can be traced.

nanananda_verbatim: Our entire saṃsāric existence is a chess game between the organic, upādiṇṇa, and the inorganic, anupādiṇṇa. The four elements within this body, the grasped par excellence... and the four elements as nutrition and atmosphere are always in conflict in their game of chess.
plain_english_below: Our entire samsaric existence is a chess game between the organic, upadinna, and the inorganic, anupadinna. The four elements within this body, the grasped par excellence... and the four elements as nutrition and atmosphere are always in conflict in their game of chess.
tts_line: Our entire samsaric existence is a chess game between the organic, upadinna, and the inorganic, anupadinna. The four elements within this body, the grasped par excellence... and the four elements as nutrition and atmosphere are always in conflict in their game of chess.
